sub-flow.doc:name: Get Issues By Type Global Subflow

sub-flow.name: getRecentlyCreatedIssuesGlobalSubflow
sub-flow.doc:name: Get Recently Created Issues Global Subflow

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 import * from dw::core::Dates output application/json
var daysAgo = vars.daysAgo as Number default 10 var dateStr = "-" ++ daysAgo ++ "d" --- { "jql": "created >= " ++ dateStr ++ " ORDER BY created DESC", "maxResults": 100, "fields": ["summary", "status", "issuetype", "priority", "assignee", "created", "updated", "project"] }

logger.doc:name: Issues Logger
logger.message: Retrieved #[payload.total default 0] issues created in the last #[vars.daysAgo default 10] days
